basic_info.description: Panoramic Bay views, Mediterranean charm, and a private 1-car garage define this 1bd/1ba iconic Russian Hill Co-op designed by renowned architect, T. Patterson Ross. The harmonious floor plan flows from a stately living room with a Carrera marble fireplace to an elegant dining area and kitchen. A charming bedroom and bathroom complete the main level. A  spiral staircase leads to a versatile lower-level space ideal for a home office or second bedroom. Period grandeur meets modern comfort throughout. The building's enchanting courtyard garden, complete with a fountain and meandering paths, delivers seasonal delights from spring tulips to year-round citrus - celebrated at the community's cherished annual lemon party. Practical luxuries include coveted garage parking, dedicated storage, in-building laundry, and an on-site building manager. Located in Picturesque Russian Hill, minutes away from Polk Street's vibrant scene and North Beach's legendary dining. Easy access to multiple MUNI bus lines and cable cars.
